proof:
by
  intro total
  have hclaim := total { deposited := fun _ => 100, released := fun _ => 30 } 0 100 (by decide) (by decide)
  exact absurd hclaim (by decide)
reasoning: The release guard omits already-released amounts: from a healthy state (deposited 100, released 30) a release of 100 is allowed by amount <= deposited and leaves released at 130 above the 100 deposit. The concrete double-release replay demonstrates the same defect on chain.
